card.name: Its/their after a substance, before derivatives
card.fires_on: The possessive words "its" or "their" right after a named drug or chemical and "and" or "or". The next word is likely a related form such as salts, metabolites or derivatives.

modes.label: its before salts
modes.description: "its" follows a chemical name and "and" in a list of sources.
modes.example: Sources of cyanide poisoning include hydrogen cyanide and<< its>> salts, cyanogenic plants, aliph

modes.label: their before metabolites or derivatives
modes.description: "their" follows a plural drug or agent name after "or" or "and".
modes.example: concurrent exposure to oxidizing agents or<< their>> metabolites are more susceptible to developing clinical

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict "derivatives" and similar words meaning related compounds.
card.plain: It fires on "its" or "their" after a drug name, when the text is about to say "salts", "metabolites" or "derivatives".
